items.titleEn: Preview: Newcastle United v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Get the team news, stats, tactics, TV coverage and more before we head to St James' Park to face Newcastle United in the Premier League
bodyEn: We look to continue our flying start to the Premier League season when we head north to Newcastle United on Saturday (5.30pm UK), hoping the Magpies fail to clip our wings.

With international football on the back burner until spring, we can now focus on a huge run of fixtures right through the remainder of 2026 as we aim to finish a glorious year top of the pile, starting with the 200th meeting between the Geordies and us.

After five years of battles with Eddie Howe’s side, this contest should feel different with the hosts under new management, and Bruno Guimaraes swapping black and white for red and white. But with a five-point lead to protect, we’ll hope to follow up last season’s vital victory on Tyneside by picking up a sixth-straight league win.
TYNESIDE TROUBLES

Another summer of upheaval at Newcastle saw Howe’s hugely successful five-year tenure come to an end during pre-season, while Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali and Bruno Guimaraes also flew the Magpies’ nest. In their place came Al-Ahli boss Matthias Jaissle and £265 million’s worth of young players from across Europe.

A positive start brought a draw with Liverpool before beating Tottenham Hotspur, but Jaissle has since been under scrutiny after claiming just two wins from the next eight league games, leaving his side in the bottom half and the season in the balance.

Damaging 4-1 away losses at Leeds United and Coventry City caused alarm, but their home form is also a major concern. Newcastle have won just four Premier League games at St James’ Park in 2026, and their solitary win this term was a nervy 2-1 triumph over Hull City. Recent defeats to Aston Villa and Everton mean no team has lost more often on their own patch in the division this calendar year, while they drew 1-1 at Fulham before the international break.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY
Arteta: "We love travelling. It's what it is. First of all we just want to focus on the game that we have tomorrow, a really tough one, and then we'll go game by game again.

"[This game] will be even more difficult, because they will be even better prepared; they will have even more necessity to do that, and that's what we expect. We always expect the best version from the opponent. That's how we have to prepare for the game, and that's how we're going to approach it."

Jaissle: "I honestly feel privileged to be on the same touchline as [Arteta]. He has achieved something special at Arsenal in the past few years. It is a dream for a young manager coming through to be facing him for the first time, but we are opponents and competitors for those 90 minutes.

"If you face the champions, that is motivation enough. We are playing at home in front of our fans - they can be the twelfth man. The fans can give us so much power and support. This is a great opportunity, a big challenge."
TEAM NEWS
Martin Zubimendi was forced to withdraw from the field during Spain’s 3-2 loss to England during the international break,
Bukayo Saka remains sidelined with the thigh injury sustained at Bayern Munich earlier in the month, while Max Dowman will complete his three-match ban after sitting this one out.

Joelinton will miss this match as he needs to see a specialist about a thigh problem. Former Gunner Joe Willock and summer recruit Nico Gonzalez have missed training this week due to illness but should be OK, while backup goalkeeper Ewen Jaouen remains sidelined with a hamstring issue.

In better news for the hosts, Jacob Ramsey returns from suspension while Tino Livramento was back on the bench at Craven Cottage following a calf layoff. £60 million summer recruit Matthias Fernandez-Pardo has sat out recent games because of illness but is back in training.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke: In their 4-2-3-1 shape, I expect Newcastle to try to press us ferociously. That is a core principle of Jaissle, but their confidence is lower than it was on our recent visits. The squad are still getting to grips with the new man's demands, and if their press doesn’t click, you can play through them. They have faced 20 shots from fast breaks, more than anybody else this season.

Guimaraes offered the back four terrific protection, and without his presence they do not look as solid down the spine. New keeper Lukas Hornicek has kept Newcastle in several matches with a series of stellar saves that prevented 4.3 additional goals, but set pieces could be something we target, as only Crystal Palace have conceded more shots from dead-ball situations.

In attack, they have the third-lowest expected goals tally, averaging just 3.3 shots on target per match, and no Magpie has netted more than twice in the Premier League. Will Osula's pace is worth keeping an eye on, and Yoane Wissa in the No.10 role gets on the end of chances, but scoring consistently is an issue for all their forwards.

They are at their most dangerous down the left, with Lewis Hall and Harvey Barnes creating 23 chances and 43 crosses combined. No one else in the Magpies squad comes close to matching their numbers. So, Ben White or Jurrien Timber will need the defensive support of Noni Madueke when those two dynamic wide men push us onto the back foot.
FACTS AND STATS
We have won eight of our last 10 Premier League away games, and since losing 1-0 to Newcastle in November 2024, have lost just four times on the road in the league.
We have lost just two of our last 16 league games immediately following an international break (W12 D2).

We have won more Premier League games against Everton (41) and West Ham (39) than against Newcastle (38), while our 32 clean sheets against the Magpies are the most one side has against another in the competition.
Newcastle have won just one of their last 29 Premier League games against sides starting the day top of the table, and none of their last 18 since a 2-1 victory over Chelsea in December 2014.
We have won our last four league games by an aggregate score of 5-0. We last won five without conceding a goal in September/October 1987.

We are looking to become only the fifth side to reach 10 wins in as few as 11 games from the start of a Premier League season, after Chelsea in 2005/06, Man City in 2011/12, Man City again in 2017/18, and Liverpool in 2019/20, all of whom went on to win the title.
Newcastle's average of 16.5 shots faced per game is their highest on record (from 2003/04) in a campaign in the competition.
Mikel Arteta’s next win will be his 159th as a Premier League manager. It will take him above Mark Hughes (158) into 10th place for wins by managers in the competition’s history.
Martin Odegaard (110) and Declan Rice (105) are the top two players for line-breaking passes in the final third in the top-flight this season.

Only Exequiel Palacios (68) has won possession more in the Premier League this season than Newcastle’s Lewis Hall (67). Hall leads the division outright for possession won in the defensive third (41).
MATCH OFFICIALS

Chris Kavanagh has been handed this game, the second time we’ve had him in charge of one of our games this season following the 2-1 win against Chelsea. That extended his run to just one defeat in his last 17 Gunners games, which came at Anfield last season, but we have won the subsequent five fixtures, including the pivotal success at West Ham United last May, when he overturned his decision to award the Hammers a late equaliser after a VAR review.

The Magpies have also had a favourable record under the Lancastrian’s watch, winning seven of the last nine, although this is the first time he’s refereeing them this season. Kavanagh has been busy this season, dishing out four red cards in seven games as well as two penalties in his last outing - Manchester United’s 4-4 draw with Aston Villa.
Referee: Chris KavanaghAssistants: Dan Cook, Wade SmithFourth official: Elliot BellVAR: Stuart AttwellAssistant VAR: Adrian Holmes
RECENT TYNESIDE TRIPS

The Magpies have lost 38 of their 62 Premier League games against us; their joint-most losses to a side in the competition, along with Liverpool. However, on home turf, they have made life difficult for us, winning four of the last six games.

But that doesn’t include last season, as in September 2025, Nick Woltemade handed the hosts the lead, but late goals from Mikel Merino and Gabriel turned the game on its head to give us a vital early-season win.

That ended a run of three consecutive losses at St James’ Park, as we were beaten 2-0 in the Carabao Cup semi-final second leg the previous February when Jacob Murphy and Gordon got on the scoresheet. A towering header from Alexander Isak clinched the three points two months earlier, and in 2023/24 Gordon scored in controversial circumstances to clinch another single-goal win.
LIVE COVERAGE

Live commentary will be available on Arsenal.com and The Arsenal app (download now on iOS/Android) from just before kick-off, with Dan Roebuck and Adrian Clarke behind the mics to guide you through all the on-field action.
You can also find out which broadcasters are showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.

items.titleZh: 赛事前瞻：纽卡斯尔联对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将在英超客场对阵纽卡斯尔联，本文带来球队新闻、数据及战术分析。
bodyZh: 当我们于周六（英国时间下午5:30）前往北方挑战纽卡斯尔联时，我们希望延续在英超联赛中的强劲开局，并期望喜鹊军团无法阻挡我们的势头。
随着国际比赛告一段落，我们可以专注于2026年剩余时间的密集赛程，目标是以榜首身份结束这个辉煌的年份，而这场比赛也是双方历史上的第200次交锋。
在经历了与埃迪·豪球队的五年较量后，随着对手换帅以及布鲁诺·吉马良斯转会加盟，这场比赛将焕然一新。不过，带着5分的领先优势，我们希望延续上赛季在泰恩河畔取得的客场关键胜利，争取联赛六连胜。
泰恩河畔的困扰
纽卡斯尔在夏天再次经历动荡，埃迪·豪执掌五年的成功任期在季前赛结束，而安东尼·戈登、桑德罗·托纳利和布鲁诺·吉马良斯也离开球队。接替他们的是前吉达国民教练马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒，以及花费2.65亿英镑从欧洲各地引进的年轻球员。
积极的开局包括逼平利物浦以及击败托特纳姆热刺，但雅伊斯勒在随后的八场联赛中仅取得两场胜利，这让他的帅位受到质疑，球队也滑落至积分榜下半区，赛季前景充满变数。
客场4比1惨败给利兹联和考文垂敲响了警钟，但他们的主场战绩同样令人担忧。纽卡斯尔在2026年仅在圣詹姆斯公园球场赢过四场英超比赛，本赛季唯一的胜利是2比1险胜赫尔城。近期输给阿斯顿维拉和埃弗顿意味着他们在今年自然年内是联赛主场输球最多的球队，而在国际比赛日前他们与富勒姆战平1比1。
主帅言论
阿尔特塔：“我们喜欢客场作战，事实就是如此。首先，我们只想专注于明天的比赛，这是一场非常艰难的比赛，然后我们将一场一场地去踢。”
“[这场比赛]将会更加困难，因为他们会准备得更充分；他们会有更强烈的取胜需求，这就是我们的预期。我们总是期待对手拿出最好的状态。这就是我们备战比赛的方式，也是我们将要采取的态度。”
雅伊斯勒：“老实说，能和[阿尔特塔]站在同一条边线旁，我感到很荣幸。他在过去几年里在阿森纳取得了非凡的成就。对于一个初出茅庐的年轻教练来说，第一次面对他是梦想成真，但在那90分钟里，我们是对手和竞争者。”
“如果你面对的是卫冕冠军，这本身就是足够的动力。我们在主场作战，在球迷面前——他们可以成为第十二人。球迷可以给我们巨大的力量和支持。这是一个绝佳的机遇，也是一个巨大的挑战。”
球队新闻
马丁·祖比门迪在西班牙对阵英格兰的国际比赛日期间因伤退场，
布卡约·萨卡仍然因本月早些时候在拜仁慕尼黑受大腿伤势影响而缺阵，马克斯·多曼在服完这场比赛后将完成三场禁赛。
乔林顿将缺席本场比赛，因为他需要就大腿问题咨询专家。前阿森纳球员乔·威洛克和夏窗新援尼科·冈萨雷斯由于生病缺席了本周的训练，但应该无大碍，而替补门将埃文·若昂昂则因腿筋问题继续缺阵。
对主队来说较好的消息是，雅各布·拉姆齐解禁复出，蒂诺·利夫拉门托在克拉文农场之战后也回到了替补席上。6000万英镑的夏窗新援马蒂亚斯·费尔南德斯-帕尔多近期因病缺席比赛，目前已恢复训练。
战术探讨
阿德里安·克拉克：在4-2-3-1的阵型中，我预计纽卡斯尔会试图对我们进行凶猛的逼抢。这是雅伊斯勒的核心原则，但他们的自信心不如我们最近几次造访时。全队仍在适应新帅的要求，如果他们的逼抢不成功，你可以通过传球打穿他们。本赛季他们已经面临来自快攻的20次射门，比其他任何球队都多。
吉马良斯为后防线提供了极佳的保护，缺少了他的存在，他们的中轴线看起来不再那么稳固。新门将卢卡斯·霍尔内切克凭借一系列精彩扑救，阻止了4.3个预期失球，多次拯救了纽卡斯尔，但定位球可能是我们的攻击目标，因为只有水晶宫在死球情况下被对手射门的次数更多。
在进攻端，他们的预期进球数倒数第三，场均只有3.3次射门命中目标，没有一名喜鹊球员在英超中进球超过两个。威廉·奥苏拉的速度值得关注，扮演10号位的约安·维萨能够抢到落点，但持续进球是他们所有前锋面临的问题。
他们在左路的威胁最大，刘易斯·霍尔和哈维·巴恩斯联手创造了23次机会和43次传中。喜鹊阵容中没有其他人能接近这一数据。因此，当这两名充满活力的边路球员压迫我们时，本·怀特或尤里安·廷贝尔需要得到诺尼·马杜埃克的防守支援。
数据与事实
我们在最近10个英超客场中赢了8场，自从2024年11月0比1不敌纽卡斯尔以来，我们在联赛客场仅输过4次。
在国际比赛日之后的最近16场联赛中，我们只输了2场（12胜2平）。
我们在英超对阵埃弗顿（41场）和西汉姆联（39场）的胜场数多于对阵纽卡斯尔（38场），而我们在零封纽卡斯尔的32场比赛中是该赛事中单支球队对阵另一支球队最多的纪录。
纽卡斯尔在面对以榜首身份开局的球队时，最近29场英超联赛只赢了一场，自2014年12月2比1战胜切尔西以来，最近18场比赛一场未胜。
我们最近四场联赛以总比分5比0获胜。我们上一次连续五场零封取胜是在1987年9月/10月。
我们正力争成为英超赛季开始仅11场比赛就取得10场胜利的第五支球队，此前四支为2005/06赛季的切尔西、2011/12赛季的曼城、2017/18赛季的曼城以及2019/20赛季的利物浦，他们最终都赢得了冠军。
纽卡斯尔场均面对16.5次射门，是他们自2003/04赛季有记录以来的单赛季最高纪录。
米克尔·阿尔特塔的下一场胜利将是他在英超联赛中的第159场胜利。这，将使他超越马克·休斯（158场），升至该赛事历史主教练胜场榜的第10位。
马丁·厄德高（110次）和德克兰·赖斯（105次）是本赛季英超联赛中在进攻三区内传球撕裂防线次数最多的两名球员。
本赛季英超联赛中，只有帕拉西奥斯（68次）的抢断次数多于纽卡斯尔的刘易斯·霍尔（67次）。霍尔在防守三区赢得球权的次数在联赛中独占鳌头（41次）。
比赛官员
克里斯·卡纳瓦格已被指派执法本场比赛，这是本赛季我们第二次由他执法，此前我们2比1战胜了切尔西。这延续了他在我们最近17场比赛中仅输一场的记录，那场失利是上赛季在安菲尔德，但我们随后的五场比赛都取得了胜利，包括去年5月在西汉姆联的关键胜利，当时他在VAR回看后推翻了判给铁锤帮晚期扳平球的决定。
喜鹊在卡纳瓦格执法下的战绩也相当不错，最近9场赢了7场，不过这是他本赛季首次执法他们的比赛。卡纳瓦格本赛季执法繁忙，在7场比赛中出示了4张红牌，并在上一场比赛——曼联4比4战平阿斯顿维拉的比赛中判罚了2个点球。
主裁判：克里斯·卡纳瓦格；助理裁判：丹·库克、韦德·史密斯；第四官员：埃利奥特·贝尔；VAR：斯图尔特·阿特维尔；助理VAR：阿德里安·霍姆斯
近期泰恩河畔客场战绩
喜鹊在对阵我们的62场英超比赛中输掉了38场，这是他们在该赛事中对阵单支球队并列输球最多的场次（与利物浦并列）。然而，在主场，他们给我们制造了不小的麻烦，在最近六场比赛中赢了四场。
但这并不包括上赛季，因为在2025年9月，尼克·沃尔特马德曾为主队取得领先，但米克尔·梅里诺和加布里埃尔的进球扭转了局势，为我们赢得了关键的赛季初期胜利。
这终结了我们在圣詹姆斯公园球场的三连败，因为在前一年2月的联赛杯半决赛次回合中，我们以0比2落败，当时雅各布·戈登和雅各布·墨菲取得了进球。两个月前，亚历山大·伊萨克的一记头球破门锁定了三分，而在2023/24赛季，戈登在充满争议的情况下再次打入单刀球制胜。
现场直播
比赛临近开始时，Arsenal.com和官方App（现已在iOS/Android平台上线）将提供现场解说，丹·鲁布克和阿德里安·克拉克将在麦克风前带您体验场上所有的精彩瞬间。
您还可以在世界各地查询哪些转播商正在直播这场比赛。

items.titleEn: Archie Stevens joins Sutton on short-term loan
items.summaryEn: The young midfielder will be with the National League side until January 10
bodyEn: Archie Stevens had joined Sutton United in the National League on loan until January 10, 2027.
The 20-year-old joined our Academy in September 2025 from Rangers, when he signed a professional contract with us following an impressive trial period.

With previous experience in senior Scottish football, Archie has continued to develop as part of our under-21s side. The England youth international made his senior debut for Rangers at the of 16 before spending the second half of the 2024/25 campaign on loan at Dunfermline Athletic.
We wish Archie all the best for his loan spell with Sutton United and look forward to seeing his continued development.
The loan is subject to the completion of regulatory processes.

items.titleZh: 阿奇·史蒂文斯短期租借加盟萨顿联
items.summaryZh: 年轻中场租借加盟萨顿联，租期至1月10日。
bodyZh: 阿奇·史蒂文斯已租借加盟英格兰全国联赛的萨顿联队，租期至2027年1月10日。
这位20岁的中场球员于2025年9月从流浪者加盟我们的青训学院，此前他在试训期间表现出色并与我们签下了职业合同。
凭借在苏格兰成年联赛的效力经验，阿奇在我们的U21梯队中继续成长。这位英格兰青年国脚在16岁时就代表流浪者完成了成年队首秀，随后在2024/25赛季的下半程被租借至邓弗姆林竞技。
我们祝愿阿奇在萨顿联的租借期间一切顺利，并期待看到他继续取得进步。
本次租借尚待完成相关监管程序。

bodyEn: Arsenal have suffered a further injury blow after it was revealed that one of their most famous supporters, New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani, tore his achilles while playing in a friendly soccer match on Thursday and is out of action until next summer.

Not long after Mikel Arteta confirmed Bukayo Saka may not return to action before Christmas as he continues rehabilitation from a thigh injury, Mamdani added to Gunners woe by outlining how and why he is also sidelined for some time during a press conference that began with him announcing plans to close the Rikers Island jail complex.

“We [City Hall] played a friendly game against the press corps last night [of] soccer,” said Mamdani on Friday morning, sporting crutches as well as a protective boot that he will require the use of for six to eight weeks. “Which we won 10-5. I scored a goal soon after getting on the pitch and forgot that I was 35. And soon after, I tore my achilles and will play soccer in about nine months.”

The match took place at an indoor pitch near City Hall and, according to reports, Mamdani’s injury was non-contact and occurred while he was running onto a pass. An unfortunate injury but also an avoidable one – as Mamdani, who is only a few months into a four-year contract with the city of New York, revealed in Friday’s press conference, he did not stretch before taking to the field on Thursday night. For Mamdani, it is very much a case now of feet up for the remainder of Arsenal’s season, starting with Saturday’s Premier League visit to Newcastle United.

“It is time to finally close Rikers Island,” Mamdani said in his principal statement on Friday. “For decades, New Yorkers have demanded a correctional system that is safe and humane. This plan puts us on a path to deliver just that: closing Rikers, reducing pretrial detention, tackling the case delays that deprive people of their right to a speedy trial and investing $146m in the evidence-based supports that helps break the cycles of incarceration.”

New York faces a legally mandated deadline to close Rikers by August 2027, a deadline that was established under legislation passed by the city council in 2019 and signed into law by the then mayor, Bill de Blasio.

Mamdani has previously used sport to engage with people held at Rikers Island, visiting the jail complex in July to watch the World Cup semi-final between England and Argentina. A month earlier, the Guardian was granted rare access to Rikers, where nearly 2,000 incarcerated people gathered across the complex to watch the New York Knicks play in their first NBA finals in 27 years.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳遭遇新的伤病打击，佐赫兰·马姆达尼跟腱撕裂将缺阵
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳知名球迷、纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼踢球时跟腱撕裂，将缺阵九个月。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳遭遇又一次伤病打击之际，据透露，他们的知名球迷之一、纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼周四在参加一场足球友谊赛时跟腱撕裂，将缺阵至明年夏天。
就在米克尔·阿尔特塔确认布卡约·萨卡在继续进行大腿伤势康复期间可能无法在圣诞节前复出后不久，马姆达尼在一场新闻发布会上讲述了他受伤的经过和原因，给阿森纳的伤病名单再添愁云。发布会的开场是他宣布了关闭赖克斯岛监狱群的计划。
马姆达尼于周五上午拄着拐杖并穿着防护靴出席，他将在未来六到八周内持续使用这些装备。“我们（市政厅）昨晚与媒体记者踢了一场足球友谊赛，”马姆达尼说道。“我们以10比5赢了。我上场不久后进了一个球，却忘了自己已经35岁了。不久之后，我的跟腱就撕裂了，大约九个月后才能重新踢球。”
这场比赛在市政厅附近的一个室内球场举行。据报道，马姆达尼是在无对抗情况下奔向传球时受伤的。这是一个不幸却本可避免的伤情——正如马姆达尼在周五的新闻发布会上透露的那样，他周四晚上上场前并没有进行拉伸。对于马姆达尼来说，接下来的阿森纳整个赛季他都只能高高架起双脚观看比赛了，首先是周六英超客场对阵纽卡斯尔联的比赛。
“是时候最终关闭赖克斯岛了，”马姆达尼在周五的主旨声明中表示。“几十年来，纽约人一直要求建立一个安全且人道的人口矫正系统。这项计划让我们走上了实现这一目标的道路：关闭赖克斯岛、减少审前羁押、解决剥夺人们接受快捷审判权利的案件拖延问题，并投资1.46亿美元用于基于证据的支持措施，以打破监禁的恶性循环。”
纽约面临着法律规定的2027年8月之前关闭赖克斯岛的最后期限，该期限是根据市议会于2019年通过并由时任市长比尔·德布拉西奥签署成为法律的立法确定的。
马姆达尼此前曾利用体育与关押在赖克斯岛的人员进行互动，他曾于7月访问该监狱群，观看英格兰与阿根廷之间的世界杯半决赛。一个月前，《卫报》获准罕见地进入赖克斯岛，当时近2000名被关押人员聚集在整个监狱群中，观看了纽约尼克斯队27年来的首场NBA总决赛。

items.summaryEn: Caitlin Foord has been named AFC Asian International Player of the Year for 2026.
bodyEn: Caitlin Foord has been named AFC Asian International Player of the Year for 2026.
It’s the first time Foord has won the award after being nominated alongside Alanna Kennedy and Yui Hasegawa.

She is now the first player to win all three awards at the AFC Annual Awards, having won AFC Asian Women's Young Footballer of the Year in 2011, and being named the AFC Asian Women's Footballer of the Year in 2016.
Foord has been recognised for her achievements both at club and international level.
For Matildas, she scored a vital goal in the 2026 AFC Women’s Asian Cup semi-final against China, and assisted Sam Kerr’s winning goal.
She also helped make history for us in the inaugural FIFA Women’s Champions Cup final, scoring the winner in extra-time of our 3-2 victory over Corinthians.
Congratulations, Caitlin!

items.titleEn: Every word of Renée’s pre-West Ham press conference
items.summaryEn: The head coach looks ahead to Sunday's WSL return as we prepare to face West Ham United at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: Renée Slegers put some time aside after Thursday's 2-0 defeat to Lyon to look ahead to Sunday's game against West Ham United.
We return to Women's Super League action at Emirates Stadium in a 2.30pm kick-off this weekend.
Here's everything our head coach had to say on the following subjects...

on goalkeeper decisions when Van Domselaar is back from injury:Daph has trained with us for weeks. She looks really good in training. Like I said, we have Anneke Borbe, who's a really good goalkeeper and who's been in goal for us last year, this year. We have Daphne, who's now coming back and available to play from now on. We have Misa, who's grown into the environment, so we have a lot of quality. And then we have Amy Liddiard from the academy with us, growing as well. And then Isabella Damm, who came to us this year, she's a very, very big talent. So our goalkeeper department is really strong at the moment.

on how confident we are about competing to finish in the WSL Champions League spots:It's November, and what it looks like in May is important. We're well aware that we are in a position where every point counts, but we'll have to live with that. That's always the structure here at Arsenal. We've done this to ourselves, so that's the situation we're in. We're well aware, we know reality, and it doesn't change the stress or the focus or the way we do it. But we know how much is going to be needed on Sunday against West Ham.

on if we’ll see Blackstenius, Kelly, Caldentey or Cerci back before Christmas:Stina is the first one now. She's managing achilles and has played with achilles that has been in pain for a while. She's now chosen to offload her to get it calm, and that's progressing well. She's not available for the rest of this block. There's a longer window, and then let's see where she's at after that. Next one was Chloe Kelly, still managing the same hamstring issues. So there's no timeline at the moment. Mariona and Selina will most likely be back after Christmas.

on if she’s satisfied with our recruitment process:I don't think that's a concern. I think we've had a really big window, this window, and there's full alignment on the board. And for some players it goes quicker, and for some players it takes longer. We also have the context of the situation that we're in with the team, that it is difficult, and that also plays in, of course. But it's not perfect always. I think we have a really good process to make it as good as possible. But yes, like everything else in life, not everything is always perfect, but there's full alignment.

on managing squad rotation: It’s a real big focus for me to make good decisions there, to have consistency, tactical decisions, partnerships on the pitch, freshness on the pitch, all those things, so that’s a puzzle that we put together for every game, together with the staff, and that’s what we’ll do ahead of West Ham too.

on Reuteler’s position: We’ve had quite a lot of conversations, Gery and me, about obviously where she plays for Switzerland, the position she ends up on the pitch, the role she played for Frankfurt in the 4-4-2 diamond, where she was on the right side. We don’t play those systems that they play, so we have to look at her qualities and whether that fits in the way we play. You probably would have seen it that we try to have her in those positions as much as possible, then it’s whether you’re a 10 or a 6 or an 8 or a wide forward, it’s getting those players in the areas where they’re at their best and where they’re comfortable. That’s what we’ve been looking at. What it then means is that your defensive responsibilities are different in different positions, that’s the theory behind it, she’s a versatile player and I think we’ve tried everything we could to put her in positions where she’s at her best.

on having such a deep and talented squad:Since I’ve been at Arsenal, that’s been my life, so it’s nothing new. We have a quality squad, we have a lot of games and from the moment I got into the interim role, that’s been the situation, and that’s no different [now]. I think what’s different now is the results have been tougher, so everything is being zoomed in on, and for us as well of course.
on the demanding schedule:These players are robust, most can do three 90s a week, that’s what they’re built for as well, so like I said, making good decisions every game.

on the challenge West Ham will pose:Let’s see; it’s the same bonanza we said, is it back four or back five? Are they going to be brave, are they going to press, or are they going to sit back? That’s always the question when teams come to the Emirates, so let’s see what they do. We know they have threats and we know they can be dangerous, so we’ll have to be really good on Sunday.

items.titleZh: 雷妮赛前新闻发布会全记录
items.summaryZh: 主教练雷妮展望周日阿森纳在酋长球场对阵西汉姆联的英超比赛。
bodyZh: 在周四以0比2不敌里昂之后，雷妮·斯莱格斯抽时间展望了周日对阵西汉姆联的比赛。
本周末下午2点30分，我们将在酋长球场重返英格兰女子超级联赛的赛场。
以下是我们的主教练针对以下话题所说的一切……

关于范多姆瑟拉尔伤愈复出的门将决定：达芙已经和我们一起训练好几周了。她在训练中表现非常出色。就像我说的，我们有安妮克·博尔贝，她是一位非常优秀的门将，去年和今年都为我们把守过球门。达芙现在回来了，从现在开始可以上场比赛了。我们还有米萨，她已经融入了这个环境，所以我们拥有很高的水平。此外，青训营的艾米·利迪亚尔也和我们在一起，并且在不断成长。还有今年来到这里的伊莎贝拉·达姆，她是一个非常非常大的天才。所以目前我们的门将阵容真的很强。
关于我们对争夺英超欧冠席位的信心：现在是11月，5月份的情况才是最重要的。我们清楚地认识到，我们处于一个每一分都很关键的位置，但我们必须接受这一点。阿森纳这里一向都是这样的结构。这是我们自己造成的，所以这就是我们所处的境地。我们心知肚明，我们了解现实，但这并没有改变压力、专注度或我们做事的方式。但我们知道周日对阵西汉姆联需要付出多大的努力。
关于我们是否能在圣诞节前看到布莱克斯蒂尼乌斯、凯利、卡尔登泰或切尔西复出：斯蒂纳现在是第一个。她一直在处理跟腱问题，带着疼痛的跟腱踢了一段时间球。她现在选择减轻负担让它平静下来，目前进展顺利。在这个阶段的剩余时间里她无法出场。这是一个较长的窗口期，然后让我们看看她之后的恢复情况。下一个是克洛伊·凯利，她仍在处理同样的腿筋问题。所以目前还没有时间表。马里奥娜和塞利娜很可能在圣诞节后复出。
关于她是否对我们的招募流程满意：我不认为这是一个问题。我认为我们在这次转会窗引进了很多球员，董事会上下完全一致。对于某些球员来说进展更快，而对于某些球员来说则需要更长的时间。我们也有球队所处环境的背景，这是困难的，当然这也会产生影响。但它并不总是完美的。我认为我们有一个非常好的流程来使其尽可能完美。但是是的，就像生活中的其他事情一样，并非每件事总是完美的，但大家目标完全一致。
关于管理阵容轮换：对我来说，在那里做出好的决定是一个真正的重点，要保持连贯性、战术决定、球场上的搭档关系、球场上的体能新鲜感，所有这些事情，所以这是我们为每场比赛拼凑起来的拼图，与教练组一起，这也是我们在对阵西汉姆联之前要做的事情。

关于罗伊特勒的位置：我和杰里进行了很多对话，关于她在瑞士队踢什么位置，她在球场上最终占据的位置，她在法兰克福4-4-2菱形中场中扮演的角色，当时她在右路。我们不踢他们踢的那些体系，所以我们必须看看她的特质是否适合我们的踢球方式。你可能已经看到了，我们尽量让她尽可能多地出现在这些位置上，然后无论是10号、6号、8号还是边锋，都是要把这些球员放在他们表现最好、最舒服的区域。这就是我们一直在寻找的。这意味着你在不同位置上的防守职责是不同的，这就是背后的理论，她是一名多面手的球员，我认为我们已经尽了一切努力把她放在她表现最好的位置上。
关于拥有如此深厚和有天赋的阵容：自从我来到阿森纳以来，这就是我的生活，所以这并不是什么新鲜事。我们拥有一支实力强劲的阵容，我们有很多比赛，从我担任临时主帅的那一刻起，情况就是这样，现在也没有什么不同。我认为现在不同的是结果更艰难了，所以一切都被放大了，对我们来说当然也是如此。
关于密集的赛程：这些球员身体素质很强，大多数人一周可以踢三场90分钟的比赛，这也是她们的体质所决定的，所以就像我说的，每场比赛都要做出好的决定。
关于西汉姆联将带来的挑战：让我们拭目以待；就像我们之前说的，是四后卫还是五后卫？她们会踢得勇敢、进行逼抢，还是会退防？当球队来到酋长球场时，这始终是个问题，所以让我们看看她们会做什么。我们知道她们有威胁，我们也知道她们可能很危险，所以我们周日必须表现得非常出色。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has said Bukayo Saka may not return before Christmas as the Arsenal forward continues his rehabilitation from a thigh injury.

Saka has been out since limping off against Bayern Munich at the end of last month, and it is understood he has yet to resume light training. Arteta revealed more tests during the international break confirmed the England forward did not need surgery and that he was expected to be out for another four weeks.

When asked whether Saka could be fit for the game against Manchester United on 20 December, Arteta was unsure. “I cannot be that specific,” he said. “In four weeks’ time a lot of things can happen. Maybe it is three and then it is five.

“At the end, there are a few elements. One is the healing of that tissue – and we cannot predict exactly when that tissue is going to be in the best condition to push it. Then there is the rehab plan that we have now, what he needs to do in the gym, what he needs to do in terms of treatment and on the field.”

Arsenal will also be without Martín Zubimendi for Saturday’s trip to Newcastle after the Spain midfielder picked up a hamstring injury against England last Sunday. Otherwise Arteta has a clean bill of health, with William Saliba poised to return after a long-term back injury, although Max Dowman remains suspended after his red card against Fleetwood.

Christos Tzolis is expected to start but Arteta revealed Arsenal’s players were now banned from selecting themselves or any teammates in the Fantasy Premier League game after the Greece forward’s team was leaked before the win over Liverpool on 1 November. Tzolis had been out injured for several weeks but picked himself for the trip to Anfield, alerting their opponents. He is believed to have played his wildcard to remove all the Arsenal players from his squad.

items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔透露萨卡因大腿受伤将缺阵四周，可能圣诞节前无法复出。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，由于阿森纳前锋萨卡仍在进行大腿受伤后的康复治疗，他可能在圣诞节前无法复出。
自从在上个月底对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中因伤一瘸一拐地离场后，萨卡一直缺阵至今。据了解，他尚未恢复轻量训练。阿尔特塔透露，国际比赛日期间的进一步检查证实这名英格兰前锋不需要接受手术，预计还将缺阵四周。
当被问及萨卡是否能在12月20日对阵曼联的比赛中复出时，阿尔特塔表示不确定。“我无法给出那么具体的说法，”他说，“四周内可能会发生很多事情。也许是三周，然后也可能是五周。”
“归根结底，这里面有几个要素。一个是组织的愈合情况——我们无法准确预测组织何时会达到适合发力的最佳状态。然后是我们目前制定的康复计划，包括他在健身房需要做什麽、在治疗以及球场上需要做什麽。”
由于西班牙中场马丁·祖比门迪在上周日对阵英格兰的比赛中腿筋受伤，阿森纳也将缺少他随队前往客场对阵纽卡斯尔。除此以外，阿尔特塔的阵容保持健康，威廉·萨利巴在长期背部伤病后随时准备复出，不过马克斯·道德曼因对阵弗利特伍德时吃到红牌依然处于停赛期。
克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯预计将首发，但阿尔特塔透露，在11月1日战胜利物浦之前这名希腊前锋的球队阵容被泄露后，阿森纳球员现在被禁止在英超奇幻足球游戏中选择自己或任何队友。齐奥利斯此前因伤缺阵数周，但在客场对阵安菲尔德时将自己选入了阵容，这引起了对手的注意。据信他已经使用了外卡将所有阿森纳球员从他的阵容中移除。

items.titleEn: Arteta praises our desire ahead of Newcastle trip
items.summaryEn: Mikel looked at our impressive form and how we've evolved from winning the Premier League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta said the hunger and desire within the team is behind our record-equalling start to the campaign as we look to continue our form at St James' Park this weekend.
Nine wins from our opening 10 Premier League games eclipse the start we made last season, when we went on to lift the league title for the first time in 22 years.
Victory over Newcastle United this weekend would hand us our best ever start to a season after 11 matches and Mikel has put that form down to three key reasons.

"We are pretty pleased," he said at his pre-Newcastle press conference. "To win the amount of games that we've already done so far in the Premier League, it's extremely difficult to do, especially with some of the fixtures that we have had.
"It shows the consistency that the team is showing, and that comes down, again, to the hunger, to the desire and the quality that the team is showing in those games."
We sit five points clear of Brighton at the top of the Premier League table as we go into a run of three away matches in the next four.

Assessing the table and how we've changed as a team since last season, Mikel said: "The only thing that you can look at in this league, I think, is the next game, because look at the table, how it was looking four weeks ago.

"So we are very much aware of that, how difficult it is to win every game, and how tough everyone is finding the league this season as well. We know that the only important thing is to perform and to be better than Newcastle to beat them.

"We have certainly evolved and we are a bit different. The league has evolved, becoming different with our opposition - they have become either very extreme or very cautious, and we have to adapt and play different games in relation to that. The outcome of what we’re doing in terms of perception is different because of the way we have to score certain goals, which is good, but we need to develop and increase every area to make us impossible to beat."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔在对阵纽卡斯尔赛前称赞球队的渴望
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈到了球队的出色状态以及相比夺冠赛季的进化。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，球队内部的饥饿感和求胜欲是我们在本赛季取得追平队史纪录开局的原因，本周末我们将在圣詹姆斯公园球场力求延续良好状态。
在英超前10场比赛中取得9场胜利，超越了我们上赛季的开局，当时我们时隔22年再次捧起了联赛冠军奖杯。
本周末战胜纽卡斯尔联将为我们带来队史最佳的11场开局战绩，米克尔将这种状态归结为三个关键原因。
他在赛前新闻发布会上表示：“我们非常满意。在英超联赛中已经赢下了这么多场比赛是极其困难的，尤其是考虑到我们经历的一些赛程。”
“这展现了球队展现出的稳定性，而这归根结底还是在于球队在这些比赛中所展现出的饥饿感、求胜欲和实力。”
目前我们在英超积分榜上以5分优势领先排名第二的布莱顿，接下来将在四场比赛中迎来三个客场之旅。
在评估积分榜以及自上赛季以来球队所发生的变化时，米克尔说道：“我认为在这个联赛中你唯一能看的就是下一场比赛，因为看看积分榜，四周前它是怎样的。”
“因此我们对此非常清楚，赢得每一场比赛是多么困难，以及每个人都发现本赛季的联赛是多么艰难。我们知道唯一重要的事情就是发挥出色，并且比纽卡斯尔表现得更好才能击败他们。”
“我们确实进化了，而且有些不同。联赛已经进化了，随着对手的不同而变得不同——他们要么变得非常极端，要么变得非常谨慎，我们必须根据这些情况进行适应并打出不同的比赛。从观感上来说，我们所做事情的结果有所不同，因为我们必须打进某些进球，这很好，但我们需要在各个方面不断发展和提升，让自己变得不可战胜。”

items.titleEn: Arteta's update on Saka, Saliba and Zubimendi
items.summaryEn: The boss delivers the latest team news before we take on Newcastle at St. James' Park
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has issued an update on the fitness of our first-team squad after the international break, as we prepare to travel north to face Newcastle United on Saturday afternoon (5.30pm UK).
Our only injury concern from the November internationals saw Martin Zubimendi forced off for Spain in their 3-2 defeat to England, with what the boss revealed was a hamstring injury.
"He's out," Mikel said on Martin, "unfortunately he has a slight problem in his hamstring.
"He wasn't too concerned to be fair after the game, but after the MRI scans, it showed that there is an injury there and he's going to be out for a few weeks."
As well as missing Martin , we'll still be without Bukayo Saka for a few more weeks as the forward recovers from a muscle injury.
The boss reported that Bukayo's recovery is going well, but that he still has steps to take before he's ready for a return to action.

"We had another test, he's evolving really well, but it looks like it's going to be an eight-week injury more or less. I think he's at four [weeks] at the moment, so it's still a while for him to be back with the team."
While we'll be without Bukayo and Martin for a few weeks, we'll be able to welcome back a long-term absentee in William Saliba for our trip to Tyneside.

Wilo was on the bench for our 2-1 win over Slavia Prague in the Champions League and started for our under-21s in their 5-2 win over Aston Villa before the break, and now the Frenchman is ready for first-team action.

"He's ready, he's in good condition. We want to ramp up his minutes. He's played two games, one [behind] closed doors, and the other one more official. He did very well [in both games] and he's in good condition."
With no other specific injury concerns to note, Mikel was asked about the heavy travel load some of our players have experienced during the international window.
Brazilian pair Gabriel and Bruno Guimaraes flew back from Singapore where they'd been with their national team, but Mikel is confident they'll be ready to go at St. James' Park.
"Both Gabi and [Bruno] came back, the same as the other internationals apart from Zubi, as I mentioned, so they are in good condition.
"We have another training session this afternoon, we have to make sure we nail the preparation because we know the game to expect tomorrow, how difficult it is to play against Newcastle.
"[They have] a new manager, new ideas, obviously a new philosophy, and Bruno knows them really well, so we're ready for that."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈萨卡、萨利巴和苏维门迪的情况
items.summaryZh: 主帅公布了客场对阵纽卡斯尔联前的最新球队伤病消息。
bodyZh: 在国际比赛日结束后，米克尔·阿尔特塔公布了我们一线队球员的身体状况，我们正准备于周六下午（英国时间下午5点30分）前往北部客场挑战纽卡斯尔联。
我们在11月国际比赛日中唯一的伤病担忧是马丁·苏维门迪在西班牙2-3不敌英格兰的比赛中因伤被换下，主帅透露这是一次腿筋受伤。
米克尔谈到马丁时表示：“他将缺阵，不幸的是他的腿筋有些小问题。”
“说实话，赛后他并不是非常担心，但经过核磁共振扫描后，显示那里有伤情，他将缺阵几周。”
除了马丁缺阵外，随着这名前锋从肌肉伤势中恢复，布卡约·萨卡仍将缺阵几周。
主帅汇报说，布卡约的恢复进展顺利，但在准备好重返赛场之前，他仍有一些步骤要走。
“我们进行了另一次测试，他的恢复进展非常顺利，但看起来这大约是一次需要休战八周的伤病。我想他目前已经到第四周了，所以他回到球队还需要一段时间。”
虽然我们将缺少布卡约和马丁几周，但在我们前往泰恩赛德的比赛中，我们将迎来长期缺阵的威廉·萨利巴的回归。
此前在对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的欧冠比赛中维洛进入了替补席，并在国际比赛日之前U21以5-2战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首发，现在这位法国人已经准备好代表一线队出场了。
“他已经准备好了，状态很好。我们希望增加他的出场时间。他已经踢了两场比赛，一场是闭门进行的，另一场更正式。他在两场比赛中都表现得非常好，状态也不错。”
由于没有其他需要特别注意的伤病，米克尔被问及我们的一些球员在国际比赛窗口期间经历的繁重飞行旅程。
巴西双星加布里埃尔和布鲁诺·吉马良斯从他们随国家队前往的新加坡飞回，但米克尔对他们能在圣詹姆斯公园球场准备就绪充满信心。
“加比和[布鲁诺]都回来了，除了我刚才提到的苏维门迪之外，其他国脚也都回来了，所以他们状态良好。”
“我们今天下午还有另一堂训练课，我们必须确保做好备战工作，因为我们知道明天的比赛会有多难，知道在纽卡斯尔主场踢球有多困难。”
[他们]有一位新主帅、新理念，显然还有一种新哲学，布鲁诺对他们非常了解，所以我们已经为此做好了准备。

items.titleEn: Every word from Mikel Arteta's pre-Newcastle presser
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has been speaking to the press ahead of our trip to Newcastle United in the Premier League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta was back in front of the media after the international break as he prepares his side to take on Newcastle United at St James' Park.
A host of our stars enjoyed spells with their national teams and Mikel fielded questions on a wide range of topics, from injury news to our form over the first 10 games.
Here's everything he said:

on if Saliba is ready to start:He’s ready. He’s in good condition, we want to ramp up his minutes. He’s actually played two games, one [behind] closed doors, and the other one more official. He did very well and he’s in good condition.
on if he’s available for selection:Yes.

on when Saka might be available:We had another test, he’s evolving really well, but it looks like it’s going to be an eight-week injury, more or less. I think he’s four at the moment, so it’s still a while for him to be back with the team.

on Zubimendi going off against England:He’s out. Unfortunately he has a slight problem with his hamstring. He wasn’t too concerned to be fair after the game, but after the MRI scans, it showed that there is an injury there and he’s going to be out for a few weeks.

on a Manchester United training session being interrupted by a drone:It's very delicate, obviously. We had an episode as well against Fleetwood. You see what is happening around the world as well, so I don’t know what the solution is. Obviously the technology is growing. The ability to get into systems is growing at a really rapid rate and we need to be very aware of that, but I cannot tell you what the solution is to that.
on if there’s ever been one at our training ground:I don’t know, they are looking after that constantly just in case it happens, but obviously, what happened yesterday, it’s a very serious matter.

on talks surrounding new contracts for Rice, Raya, Timber and Hincapie:At the moment, it’s no deal [with Rice], but I think we are quite close. But he needs to confirm that; I need the phone call. I don’t have any more calls, so I have to say no deal for now.

on Guimaraes returning to Newcastle this weekend:Both Gabi and him came back, the same as the other internationals apart from Zubi, as I mentioned, so they are in good condition. We have another training session this afternoon. We have to make sure that we nail the preparation, because we know the game to expect tomorrow, how difficult it is to play against Newcastle, with a new manager, new ideas, obviously new philosophy, and Bruno knows them really well. So we’re ready for that.

on if he’ll get a good reaction from their fans:I hope so. I think he was one of the main players there, and I think he came to the club at a really important time when they had, obviously, a massive lift in terms of performance and what they have achieved altogether, which was really impressive.

on seeing Pochettino back in the Premier League:When I look at him, it's quite crazy, because four people who have been really important in my life, and I've known them for so many years, are managing four top clubs in the Premier League. So, that's the beauty of it. I spoke to him; he seems delighted, really happy, really motivated by what he's got ahead of him. So, I'm wishing him the best of luck.

on if we’re surprised to be in a better position than last season so far:We are pretty pleased. To win the amount of games that we've already done so far in the Premier League, it's extremely difficult to do, especially with some of the fixtures that we have had. It shows the consistency that the team is showing, and that comes down, again, to the hunger, the desire and the quality that the team is showing in those games.

on what point gap to second place we’d be happy with:The only thing that you can look at in this league, I think, is the next game, because look at the table, how it was looking four weeks ago. So we are very much aware of that, how difficult it is to win every game, and how tough everyone is finding the league this season as well. We know that the only important thing is to perform and to be better than Newcastle to beat them.

on if the aura at St James’ Park has slipped this season:If that's the case, [it will be] even more difficult, because they will be even better prepared; they will have even more necessity to do that, and that's what we expect. We always expect the best version from the opponent. That's how we have to prepare for the game, and that's how we're going to approach it.

on how to get all our internationals ready for this weekend:One thing is the collective feeling, which I think has been very, very positive in general, and our players are having an enormous impact with their nations. Then there are certain individuals, and in this case, as you mentioned with Zubi, because he won the first game, but then he got injured as well and lost. Or Richy, but many others as well, they have had some very, very positive things.

on how to make sure our training sessions are private from drones:As I said, I'm not a specialist. I don't have a solution. I don't have a clue. We have people who are in charge of that. There are authorities there now trying to prevent that, and that's the only thing we can do: collaborate with them and try to avoid it.

on this being our last away game outside of London for a while:We love travelling. It's what it is. First of all we just want to focus on the game that we have tomorrow, a really tough one, and then we'll go game by game again.

on if the squad have been distracted by GTA6:I haven't had that issue; 95% of the squad was on international duty, and we will try to find out how much exposure we have to these kinds of games and make sure it's the right one to perform and focus on what we have to do.
on if he plays it:No, I don't.

on if other clubs should take inspiration from Arteta’s longevity at Arsenal:I think that's something very individual, in my opinion. To move what we've done here somewhere else is completely different because we were in a very unique position compared to other clubs in England. Some of them have competed. Those clubs won Premier Leagues two years before, three years before. They were in Champions League for three years in a row. We weren't. We have an opportunity now to build something that's absolutely your choice and your decision. That's what I think about Mauricio, that he stopped and he has every ability to build something incredible. That's for sure.

on if we have to re-evaluate our valuations of potential targets in January:Yes. I think that's a big part of us and it's a big responsibility that we have towards the ownership, towards the club and what we want to build in the future because there is an element of inflation in the top five leagues, but then I just see what is happening in the Premier League, which is completely different. If you look at how much Dennis Bergkamp cost in 1995 and what would be the equivalent today to that price in the top five leagues in Europe, but then in the Premier League we'll be scratching our heads. I've done that work and it's quite astonishing.

on if securing Odegaard’s future is a priority for us:Martin is an instrumental player for us. For me, I think what he's done for the club, for the team in the last years since he's joined, he's had just an athlete's trajectory with some moments of incredible consistency and magic and some others that are a bit more difficult, but his role and my opinion of how important he is to continue to do what we're doing is critical.

on if he hasn’t been in talks about his contract yet:You know that I never talk about these things. I share with you the opinion I have of him, and I think that's a very general, unanimous feeling we have with everybody at the club.
on wanting him to be at the club for longer:Definitely yes.

on if we ever doubted Odegaard could get back to his best due to injuries:There's no doubt but sometimes yes, injuries can really stop the momentum of a player and that affects everything. It affects performance, it affects the confidence, it affects how you can perceive what he's going to have or the future. But Martin has always reacted incredibly well to any kind of situation like this because he loves the game so much, because he loves this club so much and because he does absolutely everything that he can to get back on track to his very best and you can see that he's enjoying his game so much now.

on our players playing Fantasy Premier League and the potential for line-up leaks:I’ve spoken with the squad, and with my kids as well - they’re constantly asking because they want to know! This is the kind of topic that happens in society now, and we have to deal with it. Confidentiality is critical because it’s about trust and what you’re trying to do. We’ll take measures to make sure that doesn’t happen again.

on what it was like to watch Guimaraes away to Newcastle when he played for them:Admiration at the time, no, it was a different kind of feeling! But you do realise, first of all, the presence a player has, the hunger and ambition to impose himself on the pitch at every level - and that was impressive.

on what more he can add to his game:It’s about impact, the amount of things he can do to influence and own the game. He’s getting better at it, and he’ll continue to get better at it as relationships continue to strengthen day-by-day. When you see the ability live that he has, you recognise the potential that is there.

on how the team has evolved from last season:We have certainly evolved and we are a bit different. The league has evolved, becoming different with our opposition - they have become either very extreme or very cautious, and we have to adapt and play different games in relation to that. The outcome of what we’re doing in terms of perception is different because of the way we have to score certain goals, which is good, but we need to develop and increase every area to make us impossible to beat.

on the thinking behind Hincapie potentially being close to a new deal:I prefer not to get into much detail on that - if that happens, I can explain the reasons why, but there is an understanding of how we want to do things.

on the mental strength of White and Timber:The feeling is I want them to score goals for us - Jurrien had three massive chances in the last three games, so I said to him: "if you score for the national team, you’d better score goals for us!" It’s great to see. The other full-backs as well, you see they haven’t scored and they're upset. That’s the kind of impact our players want to make every time they play, which is really good, and I’m really happy for Jurrien and Ben. With Ben especially, because I know what he’s been through and how he’s had to earn his way back.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会全盘点：纽卡斯尔之战与伤病更新
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔出席英超对阵纽卡斯尔联的赛前发布会，更新了萨利巴、萨卡及祖比门迪的伤病情况。
bodyZh: 在国际比赛日结束后，米克尔·阿尔特塔重新面对媒体，为球队客场对阵圣詹姆斯公园球场的纽卡斯尔联做准备。
许多阿森纳球星在各自国家队度过了不错的时光，米克尔回答了广泛的问题，从伤病消息到前10场比赛的状态。
以下是他的全部发言：
关于萨利巴是否准备好首发出场：他准备好了。他状态很好，我们希望增加他的出场时间。他实际上已经踢了两场比赛，一场是闭门进行的，另一场更正式。他表现得很好，状态不错。
关于他是否可以出场选拔：是的。
关于萨卡何时可能复出：我们又做了一次检测，他恢复得很好，但看起来这将是一个为期八周左右的伤停。我认为他现在过去四周了，所以他回到球队还需要一段时间。
关于祖比门迪在对阵英格兰的比赛中伤退：他缺阵了。不幸的是，他的腿筋有点小问题。说实话，赛后他并没有太担心，但经过核磁共振扫描后，显示那里有伤，他将缺席几周。
关于曼联训练课被无人机打断：这显然非常微妙。我们在对阵弗利特伍德时也经历过类似插曲。你也看到了世界各地正在发生的事情，所以我不知道解决方案是什么。显然技术在发展。进入系统的能力正在以极快的速度增长，我们需要非常清楚这一点，但我无法告诉你解决这个问题的办法。
关于我们的训练基地是否也曾出现过无人机：我不知道，他们一直在密切关注以防万一发生，但显然，昨天发生的事情是一个非常严重的问题。
关于赖斯、拉亚、廷贝尔和因卡皮耶的新合同谈判：目前，与赖斯还没有达成协议，但我认为我们已经很接近了。但他需要确认这一点；我需要这个电话。我没有更多电话了，所以我现在只能说没有协议。
关于吉马良斯本周末重返纽卡斯尔：加比和他都回来了，和其他国脚一样，除了我提到的祖比门迪，所以他们状态很好。我们今天下午还有一堂训练课。我们必须确保做好充分准备，因为我们知道明天会遇到什么样的比赛，客场对阵纽卡斯尔有多么困难，他们有新教练、新思路、新哲学，而且布鲁诺对他们非常了解。所以我们对此已经做好了准备。
关于他是否会从对方球迷那里得到良好的反应：我希望如此。我认为他是那里的主要球员之一，我认为他在一个非常重要的时刻来到俱乐部，当时他们在表现和共同取得的成就方面得到了巨大的提升，这真的令人印象深刻。
关于看到波切蒂诺重返英超：当我看着他时，这有点疯狂，因为四个在我生命中非常重要、我认识了多年的人，现在正在执教英超的四支顶级俱乐部。所以，这就是它的美妙之处。我和他谈过；他看起来很高兴，真的很开心，对眼前的任务充满动力。所以，我祝他好运。
关于对目前处于比上赛季更好的位置是否感到惊讶：我们相当满意。要在英超联赛中已经赢得这么多场比赛，这极其困难，尤其是考虑到我们所经历的一些赛程。这显示了球队所展现出的稳定性，而这归根结底还是球队在这些比赛中所展现出的饥饿感、渴望和质量。
关于对领先第二名多少积分差距会感到满意：我认为在这个联赛中你唯一能看的是下一场比赛，因为看看积分榜，四周前它是怎样的。所以我们非常清楚这一点，赢得每一场比赛有多么困难，以及每个人都发现这个赛季联赛有多么艰难。我们知道唯一重要的事情是表现得比纽卡斯尔更好并击败他们。
关于圣詹姆斯公园球场本赛季的气场是否有所下滑：如果是这样的话，那将会更加困难，因为他们会准备得更好；他们会有更多的必要性去做到这一点，这就是我们所期望的。我们总是期望对手拿出最好的版本。这就是我们如何为比赛做准备以及我们要采取的方法。
关于如何让所有国脚为本周末做好准备：一方面是集体的情绪，我认为总体而言非常非常积极，我们的球员在各自国家队产生了巨大的影响。然后是某些个体，在这个案例中，正如你提到的祖比门迪，因为他赢了第一场比赛，但随后也受伤并输了。或者里奇，还有许多其他人，他们都有一些非常非常积极的事情。
关于如何确保我们的训练课不被无人机偷窥：正如我所说，我不是专家。我没有解决方案。我一无所知。我们有专门负责此事的人员。现在有相关部门试图阻止这种情况，这是我们唯一能做的事情：与他们合作并尽量避免。
关于这是我们一段时间内最后一场伦敦以外的客场比赛：我们喜欢旅行。事情就是这样。首先，我们只想专注于我们明天的比赛，这是一场非常艰难的比赛，然后我们将再次一场一场地踢。
关于阵容是否被GTA6分散了注意力：我没有遇到过这个问题；95%的阵容都在国家队参加比赛，我们将试图找出我们对这类游戏的接触程度，并确保它是正确的方式，以便在球场上发挥并专注于我们必须做的事情。
关于他自己是否玩这个游戏：不，我不玩。

关于其他俱乐部是否应该从阿尔特塔在阿森纳的长寿中获得灵感：我认为这在我看来是非常个人的事情。把我们在这里所做的事情转移到其他地方是完全不同的，因为与英格兰的其他俱乐部相比，我们处于一个非常独特的位置。其中一些俱乐部曾竞争过。这些俱乐部在两年前、三年前赢得过英超联赛。他们连续三年进入欧冠联赛。我们没有。我们现在有机会建立一些完全是你的选择和决定的事情。这就是我对毛里西奥的看法，他停下来了，他拥有建立一些不可思议的东西的全部能力。那是肯定的。

关于我们是否必须重新评估1月份潜在目标的估值：是的。我认为这是我们很大一部分的工作，也是我们对所有权、对俱乐部以及对我们在未来想要建立的东西所承担的巨大责任，因为欧洲五大联赛中存在一定的通货膨胀因素，但随后我看到英超联赛中正在发生的事情，那是完全不同的。如果你看看丹尼斯·博格坎普在1995年花了多少钱，以及今天在欧洲五大联赛中相当于这个价格的是什么，但在英超联赛中我们会抓耳挠腮。我已经做过这项工作了，这相当惊人。
关于确保厄德高的未来是否是我们的首要任务：马丁对我们来说是一个关键球员。对我来说，我认为他在过去几年里为俱乐部、为球队所做的一切，有着运动员般的职业轨迹，伴随着一些令人难以置信的稳定性和魔法的时刻，以及其他一些更艰难的时刻，但他的角色以及我对他在继续我们正在做的事情方面有多么重要的看法是至关重要的。
关于他是否还没有进行过合同谈判：你知道我从不谈论这些事情。我和你们分享我对他的看法，我认为这是我们在俱乐部每个人都有的非常普遍、一致的feeling。
关于希望他在俱乐部待更长时间：绝对是的。
关于是否曾怀疑厄德高能否由于伤病恢复到最佳状态：毫无疑问，但有时是的，伤病确实会阻止一名球员的势头，这会影响一切。它影响表现，影响信心，影响你对未来的看法。但马丁对任何此类情况的反应总是令人难以置信的好，因为他太热爱这项运动了，因为他太热爱这家俱乐部了，因为他绝对做了他所能做的一切来回到正轨，发挥出最好的水平，你可以看到他现在非常享受自己的比赛。
关于我们的球员踢梦幻英超（FPL）以及阵容泄露的可能性：我和球队谈过，也和我的孩子们谈过——他们一直在问，因为他们想知道！这是现在社会上发生的一种话题，我们必须处理它。保密性至关重要，因为这关乎信任以及你试图做的事情。我们将采取措施确保这种情况不再发生。
关于当年他为纽卡效力时看吉马良斯在纽卡客场比赛时的感受：当时是钦佩，不，那是另一种不同的感觉！但你首先会意识到一个球员的存在感、在球场各个层面强加自己的饥饿感和雄心——这令人印象深刻。
关于他还能为自己的比赛增加什么：这是关于影响力，他能做多少事情来影响和掌控比赛。他在好转，随着关系的日益加深，他会继续好转。当你亲眼看到他拥有的能力时，你就会认识到那里蕴含的潜力。
关于球队自上赛季以来是如何演变的：我们当然已经演变了，我们有些不同。联赛已经演变，随着我们的对手变得不同——他们要么变得非常极端，要么变得非常谨慎，我们必须适应并根据这些进行不同的比赛。由于我们必须进某些球的方式，我们在外界感知方面所做事情的结果是不同的，这很好，但我们需要发展和提高每一个领域，让我们变得不可战胜。
关于因卡皮耶可能接近新合同背后的想法：我更愿意不深入探讨细节——如果发生这种情况，我可以解释原因，但对于我们想要如何做事，大家是有共识的。
关于怀特和廷贝尔的心理韧性：我的感觉是我希望他们为我们进球——尤里恩在最近三场比赛中有三次绝佳机会，所以我对他说：“如果你为国家队进球，你最好也为我们进球！”很高兴看到这一点。其他边后卫也是如此，你看到他们没有进球，他们很不高兴。这就是我们的球员每次上场时都想产生的影响，这真的很好，我为尤里恩和本感到非常高兴。特别是对本，因为我知道他经历过什么，以及他是如何赢得回到球场的路的。

bodyEn: After three Premier League defeats on the spin, Manchester City need something or someone to come along and put some pep in their step, and Fulham look like just the thing – after all, in the past 15 years these teams have played 20 times in all competitions, and City have won precisely 20 of those games. Their current run of 17 successive league wins against Fulham is the longest run of victories by one club against a single opponent in English top-flight history. It is a reflection of the changing realities of English football, and the gulf that has opened between the teams that dominate it and those who seek to challenge them, that of the top 10 such runs all but one occurred in whole or in part after 2010 and six of them have been achieved by Sheikh Mansour’s Manchester City, with Chelsea responsible for another two, Manchester United one, and Portsmouth’s postwar, 13-game supremacy over Everton – a wild ride that included two 5-0s, a 5-1, a 6-3 and a 7-0 – the anomaly. Simon Burnton
Manchester City v Fulham, Saturday 12.30pm (all times GMT)

Positivity surrounds Aston Villa despite them failing to win in four matches, the last of which ended in agonising fashion; they had to settle for a 4-4 draw at Manchester United after twice squandering a two-goal advantage. Villa should have managed the final minutes better, but a home date with Sunderland presents an opportunity to return to winning ways. Unai Emery needs to eliminate the defensive naivety that has blighted some performances and the expected absence of Matty Cash, this time owing to concussion sustained on Poland duty, would deny the Villa manager his preferred defensive lineup. This fixture threw up a classic last season, Tammy Abraham scoring a stoppage-time winner to extend the visitors’ miserable record at Villa Park. Sunderland have won on only two of their past 17 league visits, their last victory coming in 2011 courtesy of the former Villa loanee Phil Bardsley. Ben Fisher
Aston Villa v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm

The last time Alex Scott played for Bournemouth, Marco Rose was yet to taste victory in the Premier League. When the 23-year-old returns to midfield he will do so with the team in a totally different place. Bournemouth have racked up eight straight wins in all competitions before hosting Nottingham Forest on Saturday and Scott, who has been able to build his fitness during the international break after a thigh problem, may have to wait his turn owing to the form of Tyler Adams and Ryan Christie. If Rose opts for momentum, then Eli Junior Kroupi, fresh from scoring his first France goal, could make his first start of the season after sustaining a freak foot injury in pre-season. Bournemouth have hardly been short of firepower, though, with Evanilson scoring seven goals in his past eight games. BF
Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest, Saturday 3pm

Chelsea left Wearside battered and bruised after being pushed around by Brian Brobbey. The Sunderland forward bullied Wesley Fofana and Levi Colwill, who had to be substituted at half-time, and won the game’s decisive penalty with a solo run that left Xabi Alonso angry with his side’s powderpuff defending. Alonso insisted Chelsea had prepared for Brobbey’s threat; the Chelsea manager will hope they are better at putting the plan into practice when they face another target man on Saturday. Leeds head to Stamford Bridge and will look to Dominic Calvert-Lewin, fresh from helping England get over the line against Spain last weekend, to unnerve Alonso’s defenders. Jacob Steinberg
Chelsea v Leeds, Saturday 3pm

Thomas Frank’s first assessment of his new charges after taking over at Crystal Palace this week included the nuggets that “we’re conceding too many goals … we need to work on the defensive side of things with principles, attitude, everything regarding that”, and in particular “we need to work on the set pieces, that’s key”. If he can’t inspire an immediate improvement this is where this match could be decided, being as it is an encounter between the league’s worst set-piece defenders – no one comes close to the 67 shots and xG of 7.44 coughed up by Palace at restarts – and the best. Though Coventry have let in one goal from set pieces, and neither Brentford nor Liverpool have shipped any, the hosts’ set-piece xG of 1.65 is a league low, and they were equally outstanding from dead-ball situations in the Championship last season. The home side will be boosted by the return of the 6ft 4in defender Bobby Thomas, who, despite a calf injury that meant he missed the last two games and the final third of the one before that, has still made more clearances than any other Coventry player. SB
Coventry v Crystal Palace, Saturday 3pm

It may have been a slightly strange week for Tottenham fans. They have watched as their former managers Mauricio Pochettino and Thomas Frank have been installed at Manchester United and Crystal Palace respectively, while their current head coach, Roberto De Zerbi, picked up the Premier League’s manager of the month award for October. That is reflective of the improvement De Zerbi has overseen in recent weeks, with Spurs happy to move forward with the Italian and avoid the chaos enveloping some of their rivals. The long-held assumption among some connected to Tottenham that Pochettino would one day return to save the club must now be banished; De Zerbi needs full buy-in from everyone to build his project. That’s the only way Spurs can ensure they steer clear of future crises. Dominic Booth
Tottenham v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

With the temperature in Newcastle forecast to dip to 0C at kick-off, Matthias Jaissle is perhaps hoping that his team’s guests from north London (where a balmy 9C is predicted at 5.30pm) freeze in the Tyneside chill. Otherwise it is hard to envisage his young side overcoming a formidable looking Arsenal on a day when Newcastle’s head coach seeks what would be only his second win in seven games. Home fans will not merely be hurt by the sight of their much-missed former captain Bruno Guimarães wearing Arsenal colours but decidedly nervous about a fixture that precedes a run of tricky engagements involving a trip to Brighton and home dates with Manchester United and Sunderland. Jaissle’s cause could be helped should Mikel Arteta name Guimarães in his starting XI and the crowd respond to the once adored Brazilian’s defection by creating the sort of hostile atmosphere that might just galvanise a Newcastle team expected to contain the former Arsenal midfielder Joe Willock. Meanwhile Jaissle’s defence must be mindful of the threat posed by another Newcastle old boy in Mikel Merino. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Arsenal, Saturday 5.30pm

Brighton are out to prove their early-season form has been no fluke and the fixture list for November and December looks promising for their chances of retaining their lofty position. Hull, having started the season with back-to-back league victories, now appear vulnerable and have not won since that August burst. Brighton follow the trip to Humberside with a home game against Universitatea Craiova in the Conference League, then host Newcastle, and face none of the big six until a visit to Tottenham on 29 December. With Brighton having won seven of their 10 league games, tentative talk of a title challenge may not seem so fanciful come Christmas. The challenge tactically for Fabian Hürzeler’s men will be to deal with the tag of favourites for most of their upcoming games, with teams perhaps starting to wise up to Brighton’s high-pressing, vertical style. DB
Hull v Brighton, Sunday 2pm

And so it starts all over again. Manchester United’s eighth permanent manager in 13 years – not forgetting the interim spells of Ryan Giggs, Michael Carrick, Ralf Rangnick, Ruud van Nistelrooy and Darren Fletcher – was impressively quick to commit to the cause when taking a private jet from Cincinnati to Manchester immediately after his final game as USA head coach. Mauricio Pochettino needs his new, floundering team to reciprocate at Anfield. United have conceded four times in the first four minutes of a game this season, seven goals in the opening 17 minutes in total, and will have had little time to absorb instructions from their latest coach by the time they face an expectant Liverpool. United’s defensive options might tempt many managers to board the next flight out but, as a decent record against the so-called big six since the start of last season demonstrates, the team are capable of showing up when they feel like it. That is just one of the many issues Pochettino has to address. Andy Hunter
Liverpool v Manchester United, Sunday 4.30pm

Fans of neutral officiating will appreciate the fact that both Brentford and Everton have won six games refereed by Craig Pawson, who will take charge of this match. But where the two clubs’ experiences diverge is that, while Brentford have only danced to the tune of the Pawson whistle 12 times, enjoying a 50% win ratio, Everton have toiled through 33 Pawson-helmed matches for an equivalent figure of 18%. Of Everton’s past 14 Pawson-patrolled matches there has been only one victory, and 10 defeats. Pawson, meanwhile, has taken charge of five Brentford home matches and they have won every one, thanks in part to the two penalties he has awarded them (both converted), compared with the one he gave against them (missed). Jack Grealish is back having sat out Everton’s past four league games because of illness, lack of fitness and a breach of club discipline, but given that, of the three Premier League matches he has missed, Everton won the two most recent – and the other one was at Arsenal – he may not go straight back into the team. Indeed of Everton’s four league wins this season, Grealish has missed three and played only eight minutes in a fourth. SB
Brentford v Everton, Monday 8pm

bodyZh: 在经历英超三连败后，曼城需要一些改变来重振旗冠，而富勒姆看起来正是绝佳的对象。在过去15年中，两队在各项赛事中交手20次，曼城取得了全部20场胜利。他们目前对富勒姆保持着联赛17连胜，这也是英格兰顶级联赛历史上单支球队对阵单一对手的最长连胜纪录。西蒙·伯顿
曼城对阵富勒姆，周六下午12:30（所有时间均为格林威治标准时间）
尽管维拉在过去四场比赛中未尝胜绩，上一轮更是在两球领先的情况下被曼联4-4逼平，但球队上下依然保持着积极的心态。主场迎战桑德兰是维拉重回胜轨的好机会。埃梅里需要消除导致防守失误的天真态度。由于马蒂·卡什在代表波兰队期间遭遇脑震荡预计缺阵，维拉主帅将无法排出心目中的首选防守阵容。本·费舍尔
阿斯顿维拉对阵桑德兰，周六下午3点
亚历克斯·斯科特上次代表伯恩茅斯出场时，马尔科·罗斯还未在英超尝到胜利的滋味。这位23岁的中场球员回归时，球队的处境已经完全不同。伯恩茅斯在周六主场迎战诺丁汉森林之前，已经在各项赛事中取得了八连胜。斯科特利用国际比赛日恢复了大腿伤势，但由于泰勒·亚当斯和瑞安·克ристи的出色状态，他可能需要耐心等待出场机会。BF
伯恩茅斯对阵诺丁汉森林，周六下午3点
切尔西在被布赖恩·布罗贝伊冲击后，带着满身伤痕离开了威尔赛德。桑德兰前锋在对抗韦斯利·福法纳和莱维·科尔维尔时占尽优势，科尔维尔不得不半场被换下。阿隆索对球队软弱的防守感到愤怒。切尔西主帅希望他们在周六面对另一位桥头堡中锋时，能更好地执行防守计划。利兹联将做客斯坦福桥，寄希望于多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温来给阿隆索的后防线制造麻烦。雅各布·斯坦伯格
切尔西对阵利兹联，周六下午3点

items.titleEn: Match of the Week: Hammering the Irons in 2024
items.summaryEn: Watch every moment from our incredible 6-0 success after West Ham United in February 2024
bodyEn: Every week, we'll revisit a classic fixture from our past and give you the chance to watch it all over again. This week, we're going back to February 11, 2024, when we travelled to West Ham United.
Revenge was in the air as we took on West Ham United at the London Stadium in February 2024.
We had lost 2-0 at home to the Irons in December 2023 but had since been on a resurging run of form.
Would we get our own back in east London?
SETTING THE SCENE

Following back-to-back defeats to see out 2023, we found ourselves playing catch-up in the Premier League title race going into February. Victories over Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest were backed up by a statement 3-1 win over league leaders Liverpool, meaning we headed to London Stadium on a high.
This was also a big moment for midfielder Declan Rice, who was set to play his first league match back at the London Stadium since moving to us in the summer of 2023.

After ending 2023 in the top six, David Moyes' West Ham United were now four games without a win following three striaght draws and a 3-0 defeat at Manchester United. However, the Irons had beaten us twice already in 2023/24, once at Emirates Stadium as well as a 3-1 victory over Mikel Arteta's side in the Carabao Cup.
THE LINE-UPS
Following on from an enthralling 3-1 win over Liverpool in N5, Mikel Arteta made two changes to his line-up.
Jakub Kiwior replaced the injured Alex Zinchenko at full-back, with Leandro Trossard coming into the starting line-up for Jorginho following the Belgian's late strike against the Reds a week prior.
As for our hosts, David Moyes stuck with the same side that was ousted 3-0 at Old Trafford a week earlier, with Ben Johnson operating in a more advanced role down the wing.
West Ham United: Alphonse Areola, Emerson, Vladimir Coufal, Kurt Zouma, Nayef Aguerd, Edson Alvarez, Tomas Soucek, James Ward-Prowse, Mohammed Kudus, Ben Johnson, Jarrod Bowen.
Substitutes: Lukasz Fabianski, Dinos Mavropanos, Aaron Cresswell, Kalvin Phillips, Angelo Ogbonna, Divin Mubama, Oliver Scarles, Danny Ings, Maxwel Cornet.
Arsenal: David Raya, Ben White, Jakub Kiwior, Gabriel Magalhaes, William Saliba, Declan Rice, Martin Odegaard, Gabriel Martinelli, Bukayo Saka, Kai Havertz, Leandro Trossard.
Substitutes: Aaron Ramsdale, Reuell Walters, Cedric Soares, Mauro Bandeira, Mo Elneny, Jorginho, Ethan Nwaneri, Reiss Nelson, Eddie Nketiah.
HOW THE TABLE LOOKED
UK NUMBER ONE
The first six weeks of 2024 were dominated by one song, Noah Kahan's Stick Season.
The Vermont-born singer would spend one more week atop the UK charts before being replaced by Beyoncé's track, Texas Hold 'Em.
After watching this classic, check out our previous Match of the Week, when we picked up our huge victory over Manchester City in 2003.

items.titleZh: 本周比赛：2024年客场大胜铁锤帮
items.summaryZh: 回顾我们在2024年2月对阵西汉姆联的6-0大胜。
bodyZh: 每周，我们都会重温一场过去的经典比赛，让您有机会再次观看全部内容。本周，我们将回到2024年2月11日，当时我们客场挑战西汉姆联。
2024年2月，我们在伦敦体育场对阵西汉姆联时，复仇的情绪弥漫在空气中。
我们在2023年12月主场0-2输给过铁锤帮，但自那以后我们迎来了一波状态复苏的连胜。
我们能否在伦敦东部扳回一城？
赛事背景
在经历2023年末的连续失利后，进入2月的我们在英超争冠中处于追赶地位。战胜水晶宫和诺丁汉森林后，又以3-1击败领头羊利物浦，这意味着我们带着高昂的士气前往伦敦体育场。
对于中场球员德克兰·赖斯来说，这也是一个重要时刻，这将是他自2023年夏天加盟我们以来首次重返伦敦体育场参加联赛。
在2023年以积分榜前六结束征程后，大卫·莫耶斯的西汉姆联在经历三连平以及0-3不敌曼联后，已经四场比赛未尝胜绩。然而，在2023/24赛季，铁锤帮已经在酋长球场击败过我们两次，一次是在联赛中，另一次是在联赛杯中以3-1战胜米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队。
首发阵容
在N5以3-1击败利物浦之后，米克尔·阿尔特塔对首发阵容进行了两次调整。
雅库布·基维奥尔替换受伤的亚历山大·津琴科出任边后卫，莱安德罗·特罗萨德凭借上周对阵红军时的尾声进球取代若日尼奥进入首发阵容。
至于我们的主队，大卫·莫耶斯延续了上一周在老特拉福德0-3失利时的同一套首发阵容，本·约翰逊在边路扮演更靠前的位置。

替补：卢卡斯·法比安斯基、迪诺斯·马夫罗帕诺斯、阿伦·克雷斯韦尔、卡尔文·菲利普斯、安杰洛·奥邦纳、迪温·穆巴马、奥利弗·斯卡尔斯、丹尼·英斯、马克斯韦尔·科尔内。
阿森纳：大卫·拉亚、本·怀特、雅库布·基维奥尔、加布里埃尔·马加良斯、威廉·萨利巴、德克兰·赖斯、马丁·厄德高、加布里埃尔·马丁内利、布卡约·萨卡、凯·哈弗茨、莱安德罗·特罗萨德。
替补：阿隆·拉姆斯代尔、鲁埃尔·沃尔特斯、塞德里克·苏亚雷斯、毛罗·班代拉、穆罕默德·埃尔内尼、若日尼奥、伊桑·恩瓦内里、雷斯·尼尔森、埃迪·恩凯蒂亚。
积分榜形势
英国单曲榜第一
2024年的前六周被一首歌统治，即诺亚·卡汉的《Stick Season》。
这位出生于佛蒙特州的歌手在英国排行榜榜首多呆了一周，随后被碧昂丝的单曲《Texas Hold 'Em》取代。

items.titleEn: Overlap, underlap or sit back? How Premier League teams use their full-backs
items.summaryEn: The role of full-back has changed massively in recent years. We analyse how all 20 sides are approaching the positionBy Opta AnalystOverlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.” Continue reading...
bodyEn: Overlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.

Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.”

Between them, White and Calafiori have contributed to six goals for Arsenal already in the Premier League this season (White: three assists; Calafiori: one goal, two assists). No other defender has registered more than three goal involvements so far. The Arsenal duo are a great illustration of the impact full-backs can have. But, with the position more demanding than ever before, how does each Premier League team deploy theirs?

The graphic below shows the average height and width of the touches of each Premier League team’s full-backs, sorted from highest average position to lowest. The most obvious takeaway is that Arsenal’s full-backs have the highest average touch location of any Premier League side this season, coming 58.2 metres from their own goal.

That is a reflection not only of Arsenal’s territorial dominance, but also the license White and Calafiori are given to push into the attacking line. White averages 3.4 touches in the opposition box per 90 minutes, the most of any full-back or wing-back in the division. Calafiori ranks third, with 2.9.

Arsenal’s full-backs also have the narrowest average touch locations of any team, emphasising how far they have moved away from the traditional full-back role of maintaining width. Instead, they are encouraged to drift inside and operate in central areas.

Tottenham also deploy their full-backs extremely high up the pitch. For most of the campaign, that has been Archie Gray at right-back and Andy Robertson on the left. Of course, analysing a player’s influence is not limited to what they do on the ball. Thanks to Opta Vision, we can also track what they do without it.

Gray is particularly noteworthy, given his exceptional work rate. He ranks first among Premier League full-backs for underlapping runs, both in total (23) and per 90 minutes (2.9), and also ranks fourth for overlapping runs per 90 (1.8). That shows the benefit of deploying an attack-minded player at full-back, with Gray showing energy and an ability to get beyond the ball and offer another option in the final third.

Robertson is no slouch on the opposite flank, either. The 32-year-old ranks seventh for underlapping runs per 90 minutes (1.4) and sits inside the top 20 for overlapping runs per 90 (1.1). He has also received more passes ending in the final third (159) than any other full-back.

It might be more of a surprise to see Coventry’s full-backs play so high, given they have not dominated the ball at all (39.1% possession, second-lowest) and they start their attacks from deep (40.2m away from goal, sixth-lowest). It is, however, something they did to good effect in the Championship last season (average height of 56.8m, sixth-highest).

Frank Lampard has also used a back five at times, which means his wing-backs naturally play higher up, but he has been brave with pushing his defensive line up in general. Coventry have provoked the second-most offsides of any team so far (30).
That has allowed Milan van Ewijk and Jay Dasilva to push forward on the flanks. The pair have each created eight chances, with only Jack Rudoni (12) creating more for the Sky Blues.

Dasilva is a particularly important outlet down the left. He takes his touches higher up the pitch than any other full-back in the division, and Coventry have created 42.2% of their open-play chances down his side, the highest proportion of any Premier League team.

It makes sense that Nottingham Forest and Leeds also see their full-backs touch the ball high up the pitch, given they are two of the biggest users of wing-backs. That pair are two of just four teams that predominantly play with wing-backs, with the back three/five becoming a rare breed in the modern Premier League.

For Leeds, Jayden Bogle has been particularly influential going forwards. He has made more runs ending in the opposition box than any other full-back this season. They’ve come at an average of 3.9 per 90 minutes, the second-highest rate in the division, behind only Nico O’Reilly, who has played just 54.3% of his minutes at full-back.

Crystal Palace, meanwhile, are feeling the effects of losing the influential Daniel Muñoz. Despite playing solely with wing-backs, they have gone from having the highest average full-back positioning in the Premier League in 2025-26 to sitting below the league average this season. Muñoz was relentless in his work up and down the right flank last term, and his absence has clearly affected the extent to which Palace are able to push their right-sided wing-back up in those wide areas.

The Colombian is now at Nottingham Forest with his former manager Oliver Glasner. They have gone from having the fifth-lowest average touch location for their full-backs to the fourth-highest. That is not only down to Muñoz, but having someone who is able to put in consistent lung-busting runs – he is behind only Ipswich Town’s Leif Davis for the average length of his off-ball runs – helps a lot.

We can’t talk about the league’s most energetic full-backs without mentioning Adrien Truffert, who has continued where he left off last season. The Frenchman is the overlapping king, making more of those runs than any other full-back in the division (23). That comes after he made almost twice as many overlapping runs as any other player across the entire league last season. His manager, Andoni Iraola, may be gone, but he’s clearly got the same license to bomb on from Bournemouth’s new head coach, Marco Rose.

Iraola is now at Liverpool, and his full-backs are one of the most asymmetric duos in the league. Milos Kerkez – just as he did at Bournemouth under Iraola – has freedom to push forward and is one of the biggest overlappers in the league, completing 15 such runs thus far. On the other side, Ronald Araújo – who is more of a converted centre-back – plays a far more reserved role.

Manchester City are a curious case. Despite averaging the most possession in the division (65.4%), completing the most passes per game (566) and recording the highest territorial dominance, as measured by field tilt, Enzo Maresca’s team do not use their full-backs in advanced areas to exert that dominance.

Their average full-back touch location is 53.1 metres from goal, making them the fourth-deepest team in the division. That is a huge contrast from Pep Guardiola’s last season, when City ranked third-highest for average full-back positioning. There are plenty of ways to play full-back in the Premier League, but the growing importance of the position is the same for every team.
This is an article by Opta Analyst

items.titleZh: 重叠、内切还是后撤？英超球队如何使用边后卫
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳本赛季开局出色，本·怀特和卡拉菲奥里的边后卫组合触球位置高居英超之首。
bodyZh: 套边。内切。内收。传统。边后卫的角色发生了巨大的演变。这个曾经以防守为主、提供一些辅助进攻支持的位置，已经发展成为一个更加多面化的角色。
问问右后卫本·怀特就知道了，他和左路的里卡多·卡拉菲奥里一起，成为了阿森纳本赛季出色开局的重要人物。几年前在谈到这个位置时，他说：“按照[米克尔·阿尔特塔]想要的方式踢边后卫，与任何其他教练都完全不同。要想为他踢边后卫，你必须是一个中前卫、中后卫、边锋和10号球员。”
在本赛季的英超联赛中，怀特和卡拉菲奥里两人已经联手为阿森纳贡献了六个进球（怀特：三次助攻；卡拉菲奥里：一球两助）。到目前为止，没有任何其他后卫的参与进球数超过三个。阿森纳的这对双人组很好地说明了边后卫能够产生的影响。但是，随着这个位置的要求比以往任何时候都高，每支英超球队又是如何部署他们的边后卫的呢？
下图显示了每支英超球队边后卫触球的平均高度和宽度，按平均位置由高到低排序。最明显的结论是，本赛季阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置是所有英超球队中最高的，距离本方球门58.2米。
这不仅反映了阿森纳在场上的绝对统治力，也体现了怀特和卡拉菲奥里被赋予了前插进入进攻线的自由。怀特平均每90分钟在对方禁区内触球3.4次，是联赛中所有边后卫或边翼卫中最多的。卡拉菲奥所以2.9次排名第三。
阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置也是所有球队中最窄的，这强调了他们已经走得多远，不再局限于保持边路的传统边后卫角色。相反，他们被鼓励内切并在中路活动。
托特纳姆热刺也将他们的边后卫部署在球场极高的位置。在大部分比赛中，右后卫是阿奇·格雷，左后卫是安迪·罗伯逊。当然，分析一名球员的影响力不仅限于他在有球时的表现。多亏了Opta Vision，我们还可以追踪他们在无球时的表现。
鉴于其出色的工作投入度，格雷尤其值得关注。他在英超边后卫的内切跑动中排名第一，无论是总数（23次）还是每场90分钟（2.9次），同时他在每90分钟的套边跑动中也排名第四（1.8次）。这显示了在边后卫位置上部署一名进攻型球员的好处，格雷表现出了活力以及超越球并为进攻三区提供另一种选择的能力。
罗伯逊在另一侧边路也毫不逊色。这位32岁的球员在每90分钟内切跑动中排名第七（1.4次），在每90分钟套边跑动中稳居前20名（1.1次）。他还接收了比任何其他边后卫更多的终结在进攻三区的传球（159次）。
看到考文垂的边后卫位置如此靠前可能会让人感到有些惊讶，因为他们根本没有在控球率上占优（39.1%的控球率，倒数第二），而且他们的进攻发起位置很深（距离球门40.2米，倒数第六）。然而，他们在上赛季的英冠联赛中就很好地运用了这一点（平均高度56.8米，排名第六高）。
弗兰克·兰帕德有时也会使用五后卫阵型，这意味着他的边翼卫自然会踢得更高，但他在整体上推动防线前压方面一直非常勇敢。考文垂目前制造了英超第二多的越位次数（30次）。
这使得米兰·范埃维克和杰伊·达席尔瓦得以在边路向前推进。这两人各自创造了8次机会，天蓝色军团中只有杰克·鲁多尼（12次）创造了更多机会。
达席尔瓦是左路一个特别重要的出球点。他在球场更靠前的位置触球，超过了联赛中的任何其他边后卫，考文垂在进攻三区有42.2%的运动战机会都是通过他的这一侧创造的，这是所有英超球队中最高的比例。
诺丁汉森林和利兹联的边后卫触球位置也很高，这合情合理，因为他们是两支大量使用边翼卫的球队。这两支球队是仅有的四支主要使用边翼卫踢球的球队之四，三后卫/五后卫阵型在现代英超联赛中已不多见。
对利兹联来说，杰登·博格尔在进攻端的表现极具影响力。本赛季他完成的进入对方禁区的跑动次数超过了任何其他边后卫。他们的平均频率为每90分钟3.9次，在联赛中排名第二高，仅次于尼科·奥赖利，而后者只有54.3%的出场时间是踢边后卫。
与此同时，水晶宫正感受到失去有影响力的丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯的影响。尽管他们完全采用边翼卫阵型，但他们的边后卫平均战术定位已经从2025-26赛季英超联赛中最高，跌至本赛季的联赛平均水平以下。穆尼奥斯上赛季在右边路的上下奔跑不知疲倦，他的缺席显然影响了水晶宫将右边翼卫推到这些宽广区域的程度。
这位哥伦比亚球员目前效力于诺丁汉森林，与其前任主帅奥利弗·格拉斯纳重聚。他们的边后卫平均触球位置已经从倒数第五跃升至第四高。这不仅归功于穆尼奥斯，还因为拥有一个能够持续进行长距离冲刺的球员——他在无球跑动平均长度上仅次于伊普斯维奇镇的利夫·戴维斯——这带来了巨大的帮助。
提到联赛中最具活力的边后卫，就不能不提阿德里安·特吕费尔，他延续了上赛季的出色状态。这位法国人是套边之王，他的这类跑动次数比联赛中任何其他边后卫都要多（23次）。此前在上个赛季，他的套边跑动次数几乎是整个联赛中其他任何球员的两倍。他的主帅安多尼·伊劳拉可能已经离开，但他在伯恩茅斯新主帅马科·罗斯的麾下，显然获得了同样的自由向前冲击的许可。
伊劳拉现在执教利物浦，他的边后卫是联赛中最不对称的双人组之一。米洛斯·克尔克兹——正如他在伊劳拉手下的伯恩茅斯那样——拥有前插的自由，并且是联赛中最主要的套边球员之一，到目前为止已经完成了15次此类跑动。在另一侧，罗纳德·阿劳霍——他更像是一个由中后卫改造成地球员——扮演着更加保守的角色。
曼城是一个奇怪的例子。尽管恩佐·马雷斯卡率领的球队拥有联赛最高的平均控球率（65.4%）、完成了最多的单场传球（566次），并记录了以球场倾斜度衡量的最高领地统治力，但他们并没有利用边后卫在先进区域来施加这种统治力。
他们边后卫的平均触球位置距离球门53.1米，是联赛中第四靠后的球队。这与佩普·瓜迪奥拉执教的最后一个赛季形成了巨大对比，当时曼城边后卫的平均定位排名第三高。在英超联赛中踢边后卫有很多种方法，但这个位置日益增长的重要性对每支球队来说都是一样的。
这是一篇由Opta Analyst撰写的文章。

items.summaryEn: Storey made 501 appearances for Arsenal from 1965He won 19 England caps and finished career at FulhamArsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.

Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list.
Storey, who represented England on 19 occasions from 1971-73, earned respect for his uncompromising approach and versatility, also featuring at right-back.

Storey died in hospital after a short illness, surrounded by his family. Arsenal said: “Everyone at Arsenal is deeply saddened by the passing of 1970-71 Double winner Peter Storey. All our thoughts are with his family and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.”

Born in Surrey, Storey began his career at Arsenal and made his debut shortly after his 20th birthday in 1965. He is fondly remembered by the club’s fans for scoring a stoppage-time penalty in the 1971 FA Cup semi-final against Stoke that forced a replay and kept the Double dream alive.

Storey left for Fulham in 1977 and retired eight months later when his contract was cancelled, going on to own a pub in north London. He was later convicted of several criminal offences, including financing a plot to counterfeit gold coins and smuggling pornography. He released an autobiography, True Storey: My Life and Crimes as a Football Hatchet Man, in September 2010.

Storey’s family said: “We are deeply grateful for the many kind messages, tributes and good wishes we have received. It has been a great comfort to see the affection and respect in which he was held by so many, both within the football community and beyond.”

items.titleZh: 阿森纳双冠王得主兼英格兰国脚彼得·斯托瑞去世，享年81岁
items.summaryZh: 前阿森纳中场、1971年双冠王功臣彼得·斯托瑞逝世，享年81岁。
bodyZh: 阿森纳向彼得·斯托瑞致以敬意。这位前英格兰中场球员去世，享年81岁，他是阿森纳1971年双冠王阵容的关键成员。
斯托瑞效力于伯蒂·米率领的球队，在那个阿森纳历史上最著名的赛季中夺得甲级联赛冠军和足总杯冠军。他为俱乐部出场501次，在队史出场次数榜上排名第八。
斯托瑞在1971年至1973年间代表英格兰国家队出场19次，他以凶悍的防守风格和多面手属性赢得尊重，也曾担任右后卫。
斯托瑞在经历短暂疾病后于医院去世，家属陪伴在侧。阿森纳表示：“阿森纳的每个人都对1970-71赛季双冠王得主彼得·斯托瑞的离去深感悲痛。在这个极其悲伤的时刻，我们所有的心都与他的家属和亲人在一起。”
斯托瑞出生于萨里，在阿森纳开始职业生涯，1965年在20岁生日后不久完成首秀。俱乐部球迷对他在1971年足总杯半决赛对阵斯托克城的比赛中罚入伤停补时点球记忆犹新，这粒进球迫使比赛进入重赛，并延续了双冠王梦想。
斯托瑞于1977年转会富勒姆，并在八个月后合同终止时退役，随后在伦敦北部经营一家酒吧。他后来因多项刑事犯罪被定罪，包括资助伪造金币阴谋和走私色情制品。2010年9月，他出版了自传《真实故事：我作为足球恶汉的生活与罪行》。
斯托瑞的家属表示：“我们非常感激收到的许多暖心留言、致敬和祝福。看到足球界内外的许多人对他的喜爱和尊敬，给我们带来了极大的安慰。”

bodyEn: Declan Rice has agreed a new five-year contract at Arsenal, with the England midfielder poised to match Bukayo Saka’s status as the highest-paid player at the Premier League champions.

Representatives for Rice, who won his 82nd cap in England’s thrilling win over Spain on Sunday, have been in talks for months about extending the deal he signed in 2023 after a record £105m move from West Ham. That is believed to be worth about £250,000 a week and is due to expire in 2028, although Arsenal have the option of a further 12 months.

Rice’s new contract will expire in 2031 and includes a substantial pay rise, rewarding him for his status as one of Mikel Arteta’s key players and taking his salary to about £300,000 a week. Saka signed his new five-year contract last season.

Rice was a driving force in Arsenal ending their 22-year wait to be champions in May, although the second half of his campaign was hampered by back and hamstring injuries. The 27-year-old admitted last week he had an “average” World Cup as a result, although he looked back to his best against Spain.

Arsenal have also agreed a contract extension for Jurriën Timber, whose deal is due to expire in 2028. The Dutchman, recently back from a groin injury that forced him to miss the World Cup, has been one of Arteta’s most consistent performers since joining from Ajax in 2023.

The Arsenal manager committed his future by signing a new four-year deal last month that could take him beyond a decade in charge. Arteta and the sporting director, Andrea Berta, have prioritised securing their top players on long-term contracts over the past year and talks are believed to be ongoing with David Raya and Piero Hincapié.

items.titleZh: 德克兰·赖斯同意与阿森纳续约，成为队内薪资最高的球员之一
items.summaryZh: 赖斯同意与阿森纳续约至2031年，周薪约30万英镑，廷贝尔也同意续约。
bodyZh: 德克兰·赖斯已同意与阿森纳续签一份为期五年的新合同，这位英格兰中场将追平布卡约·萨卡，成为这家英超冠军俱乐部中薪资最高的球员。
赖斯的经纪团队与俱乐部进行了数月的谈判。周日，他在英格兰战胜西班牙的精彩比赛中赢得了个人第82场国家队出场。他此前在2023年以创纪录的1.05亿英镑从西汉姆联转会时签下的合同原定于2028年到期（阿森纳拥有延长12个月的选项），据信当时周薪约为25万英镑。
赖斯的新合同将于2031年到期，其中包括大幅加薪，以表彰他作为米克尔·阿尔特塔阵中核心球员的地位，其周薪将增至约30万英镑。萨卡则在上赛季签下了他的五年新合同。
在阿森纳于5月份结束长达22年的等待夺得英格兰顶级联赛冠军的过程中，赖斯是球队的重要推动力量，尽管他赛季的后半程受到了背部和腿筋伤病的困扰。这位27岁的球员上周承认，因此他的世界杯表现“一般”，但在对阵西班牙时他看起来已经恢复了最佳状态。
阿森纳还与尤里恩·廷贝尔就续约达成了协议，这名荷兰国脚原本的合同将于2028年到期。他最近从导致其缺席世界杯的腹股沟伤势中恢复，自2023年从阿贾克斯加盟以来，一直是阿尔特塔麾下表现最稳定的球员之一。
阿森纳主帅在上个月签署了一份为期四年的新合同，这可能会让他在俱乐部的执教时间超过十年。在过去的一年里，阿尔特塔和体育总监安德烈·贝尔塔一直将确保核心球员签订长期合同作为首要任务，据信目前正在与大卫·拉亚和皮耶罗·因卡皮耶进行续约谈判。
